supports_model.mismatch_notes: Code equals Eq. (1) in expanded form, including the exact theta->0 limit, and inverts it with R_post - t_post. The printed Eq. (2) omits t_post, but the paper's own Table 2 transition openings (0.418/0.454/0.568 mm) agree with the code form and not with the printed Eq. (2) (0.366/0.395/0.492 mm), so Eq. (2) carries a typographical omission. A_cg = pi/4 (Dcg^2 - Dpr^2) is the annulus geometry of the named diameters; Son gives no printed formula. The registry author list ('Son, Hong, and Koo') is wrong; the authors are Son, Radhakrishnan, Koo, Kwon and Kim.

comparison.source: Eq. (1), PDF p.2 (printed 859): A_min = pi/sin(th)[(R_post - t_post)^2 - (R_post - t_post - L sin th cos th)^2]
comparison.implementation: pi*(2 r_f L cos th - L^2 sin th cos^2 th), r_f = D_post/2 - t_post
comparison.verdict: ALGEBRAICALLY_IDENTICAL; theta->0 limit 2 pi r_f L is exact and also covers Son's 0 deg tip (Table 1)

comparison.source: Eq. (2), PDF p.4 (printed 861), as printed with R_post
comparison.implementation: smaller-root inverse of Eq. (1) with r_f = R_post - t_post
comparison.verdict: CODE_FOLLOWS_EQ1_CONSISTENT_FORM; printed Eq. (2) disagrees with the paper's Table 2

comparison.source: Table 2, PDF p.3: transition openings 0.418, 0.454, 0.568 mm at 0, 20, 40 deg (D_post 8, t_post 0.5, D_cg 4.55, D_pr 3 mm from Table 1, PDF p.2)
comparison.implementation: transition_opening reproduces 0.417946, 0.454243, 0.568310 mm; printed Eq. (2) would give 0.365703, 0.395456, 0.492309 mm

comparison.source: PDF p.2: past the transition the minimum area becomes the constant center-gap area
comparison.implementation: A_eff = min(A_tip, A_cg) (registry relation); the MDO keeps A_tip <= frac*A_cg as an inequality

comparison.source: Eq. (3), PDF p.4: Cd defined on A_min or A_cg by branch, measured (Fig. 6b)
comparison.implementation: MDO uses a constant radial Cd input (injector_cd_fuel = 0.75); no Son Cd map
comparison.verdict: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_AS_SOURCE_MAP (repository input; Son provides no universal Cd-versus-stroke map)

model_review.citation_vs_support: Equations and Table 2 are correctly located in the cited paper. The registry author list at raosim/model_registry.py:113 ('Son, Hong, and Koo') is wrong; the PDF p.1 authors are Min Son, Kanmaniraja Radhakrishnan, Jaye Koo, Oh Chae Kwon and Heuy Dong Kim. This is a citation-metadata error, not a physics error.
model_review.software_verification: Benchmarks in the registry match the published Table 2; no new tests were run by this review.
model_review.physical_validation: NOT_ESTABLISHED: Son's data are atmospheric water/air cold-flow spray tests; geometry identities only.
model_review.physics_finding: No physics change required. Source-internal typo in printed Eq. (2) (t_post omitted) is corroborated by the source's own Table 2; code is correct.
remaining_uncertainties: Cd versus stroke for a new geometry (Son Eq. 3 is a definition, not a correlation)
applicability of the 0.1 mm uniform-sheet limit beyond Son's water/air rig and geometry
the 0.95 transition fraction is a repository margin
hot-fire behaviour across the transition (Son p.4 warns of possible instability)

equation_links.reason: Code equals Eq. (1) in expanded form (ratio 1.000000000 at 0/20/40 deg) and inverts it with R_post - t_post.
Printed Eq. (2) omits t_post (typo); the code follows the t_post form that reproduces the paper's own Table 2 openings, so the printed form is cited, not implemented.
